## Checklist

- [ ] I added entries in **alphabetical order** in the right section
- [ ] Links go to the official site, Steam page, or source repo
- [ ] Descriptions are one sentence, end with a period, and avoid hype words
- [ ] Games have exactly one status tag (`Live`, `Early Access`, `Beta`, `Alpha`, `Playtest`, `In Development`)
- [ ] It's **not** a private server/emulator of a commercial game, and it hasn't shut down
- [ ] I'm affiliated with this project (tick if yes — that's fine, just let us know)
